DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵の紛失について伺います。どこの鍵をなくされ、今どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will ask about your lost keys. What keys did you lose, and what difficulty are you having now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の鍵と自転車の鍵を付けた輪がなくなりました。買い物の帰りに気づき、今は家に入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅と自転車の鍵の輪をなくし、買い物帰りに気づいて家へ入れないと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost a ring with my house and bicycle keys. I noticed on my way home from shopping, and now I cannot enter my house.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you lost a ring holding your house and bicycle keys, noticed on the way home from shopping, and cannot enter your home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後にその鍵を手に取った場面は覚えていますか。なくしたと思う場所と分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the last time you held them? I will ask that separately from where you think you lost them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自転車に鍵をかけたときは持っていました。その後の店で落とした気はしますが、店の中で見た覚えはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に自転車の施錠時に持っていた事実と、その後の店で落としたという推測を分けて説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had them when I locked my bicycle. I feel I dropped them at the shop afterward, but do not remember seeing them inside the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the fact that you last had them while locking your bicycle from your guess that you dropped them at the shop afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵の本数や、輪に付いている物の特徴を教えていただけますか。住所の書かれたものも一緒でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: How many keys are there, and what is attached to the ring? Is anything showing your address attached too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵は二本で、布の青い飾りが付いています。住所や部屋番号を書いた札は付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵二本と青い布の飾りという特徴を伝え、住所や部屋番号の札は付いていないと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two keys and a blue fabric decoration. No tag showing my address or room number is attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe two keys and a blue fabric decoration, and say there is no address or room-number tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴で照会します。ご自宅に入るため、連絡できるご家族や管理する方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will search using those features. Is there a family member or property manager you can contact to enter your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同居の家族は出張中なので、管理会社へ連絡するつもりです。ここで届ければ、開けてもらえるという意味ではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同居家族が不在で管理会社へ連絡すると伝え、警察への届出が開錠を意味しないか確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family member who lives with me is away on business, so I plan to contact the management company. Reporting it here does not mean you will unlock my home, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your cohabiting family member is away and you will contact the management company, and check that a police report does not mean unlocking your home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵の相談受付と、住居の開錠は別の対応です。届け出後の連絡先には、今お使いの電話番号を登録するご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Taking a report about keys and unlocking a residence are separate services. Would you like your current phone number registered for contact after the report?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の携帯番号でお願いします。管理会社への連絡も自分で行い、鍵が見つかった場合の照会に使う控えは持ち帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今の携帯を連絡先に希望し、管理会社へ自分で連絡しつつ鍵の照会用控えを持ち帰りたいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please use my current mobile number. I will contact the management company myself, and would like to take home the receipt used for inquiries if the keys are found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request your current mobile as the contact number, say you will contact management yourself, and ask to take home the record for inquiries about the keys. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、連絡先は用紙で確認します。受付の情報と、見つかった場合の連絡方法をご案内しますので、こちらで記入をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check your contact details on the form. Please complete it here, and we will explain the report information and how you will be contacted if they are found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。二枚ともについて、お受け取りを希望なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have missed-delivery notices. Would you like to receive the items on both notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日と今日の二枚がありますが、同じ荷物なのか別々なのか分かりません。再配達を二回頼まないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日と今日の二枚が同じ荷物か分からず、再配達を重複して頼まないようにしたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two, from yesterday and today, but do not know whether they refer to one parcel or different ones. I want to avoid requesting redelivery twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know whether yesterday's and today's notices refer to the same parcel and want to avoid duplicate redelivery requests. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず番号を一枚ずつ見比べましょう。投函された日付以外に、違いは見つかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare each number first. Can you see any difference besides the date they were left?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号は同じに見えます。今日のほうだけを使って申し込み直す前に、同じ物か確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号が同じに見えると答え、今日の票で申し込み直す前に同一荷物か照会を頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The numbers look the same. Before applying again using only today's notice, please check whether it is the same item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the numbers look the same and ask for a same-parcel check before applying again with today's notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号と現在の取扱状況を調べます。すでに再配達を申し込む操作はされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the number and current handling status. Have you already taken steps to request redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、希望日を選ぶところまでは進みましたが、最後の画面の前に閉じてしまいました。完了したか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望日選択後に最後の画面前で閉じ、再配達申込が完了したか分からないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday I got as far as choosing a preferred day, but closed it before the final screen. I do not know whether it was completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you closed it after choosing a day but before the final screen, and do not know whether the redelivery request was completed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 完了の確認ができていないのですね。その申込状況も照会しましょう。受け取り方を変更したいご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: So completion is unconfirmed. Let's check that request too. Would you like to change how you receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日は家にいないので、窓口で受け取れるか相談したいです。ただ、まだここへ取りに来てよいと決まったわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日不在のため窓口受取を相談し、まだここで受け取れると決まっていないと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will be out tomorrow, so I want to ask whether counter collection is possible. But it has not yet been decided that I can collect it here, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about counter collection because you will be out tomorrow, and confirm that collection here is not yet agreed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、今の保管先と利用できる方法を確かめてからご案内します。不在票二枚を、確認の間こちらで拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. We will advise you after checking where it is held and the available methods. May I look at both notices while checking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚とも見てください。申込の状態が分かるまでは、自分で新しい希望日を重ねて送らずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚の票を確認用に渡し、現在の申込状態が分かるまで別の希望日を重ねて送らず待つと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check both. Until I know the current request status, I will wait without sending another preferred day myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over both notices for checking and decide to wait without submitting an additional preferred day until the existing request status is known. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号、申込状況、受取方法の順に照会します。分かった内容をお伝えするまで、こちらのお席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the number, request status, then collection method. Please wait in this seat until we explain the findings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失について、先ほどお電話でもご相談なさったということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You also called earlier about losing your card, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、ここへ来る途中で家族から財布が家にあったと連絡が来ました。カードもあれば、何もしなくてよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失電話の後に家族から財布発見の連絡が来たと伝え、カードもあれば対応不要か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But on my way here, my family told me the wallet was at home. If the card is there too, is no action needed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that after your loss-report call your family reported finding the wallet, and ask whether no action is needed if the card is there too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お財布の発見と、カードへの対応の状態は分けて確認します。電話では、最後にどのような案内を聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the wallet being found separately from the status of card measures. What instructions did you hear at the end of the call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 利用停止について説明を受けましたが、もう停止になったのか、確認が続いているのか聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話で利用停止の説明を聞いたが、停止済みか確認途中か聞き取れなかったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They explained suspension, but I could not catch whether it had already been suspended or checks were still continuing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that suspension was discussed by phone, but you could not catch whether it was complete or still being checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状態を本人確認のうえで照会します。電話の受付に関する控えや、分かる情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check after verifying your identity. Do you have a note or any information about the phone report?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話した時刻と、受付番号らしいものを書いたメモがあります。暗証番号以外で、どの情報が必要か案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話時刻と受付らしい番号のメモがあると答え、暗証番号以外で照会に必要な情報の案内を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note of the call time and what seems to be a reference number. Could you explain what information is needed, other than my PIN?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have the call time and an apparent reference number, and ask what information other than your PIN is needed for the inquiry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 暗証番号は伺いません。受付の情報だけ確認しましょう。再発行について、すでにお申し込みになった覚えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will not ask for your PIN. Let's check only the report information. Do you recall already requesting a replacement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新しいカードの送付先を聞かれた気がします。ただ、再発行を申し込んだかも曖昧なので、先に進行状況を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送付先を聞かれた記憶はあるが再発行の申込自体も曖昧で、まず進行状態を知りたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I think they asked where to send a new card. But I am unsure whether I even applied for reissue, so I want to know the progress first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you recall being asked a delivery address but are unsure whether you requested reissue, and want the progress checked first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用停止と再発行の状況をそれぞれ調べます。お財布が見つかったとの連絡も、その照会に含めてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check suspension and reissue separately. May we include the news that your wallet was found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布が見つかったことも伝えてください。状態が分かるまでは使えると決めず、今後必要な手続きや費用を確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 財布の発見連絡も含めることを認め、カードを使えると決めず状況・手続き・費用を確認して選びたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please tell them it was found too. I will not assume the card is usable until I know its status, and want to choose after checking the procedures and costs needed next.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Allow the wallet's discovery to be included, and say you will not assume the card is usable, but want to check status, procedures, and costs before choosing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。発見の連絡を含めて本人確認から進めます。今の状況と次の選択肢が分かるよう、別々にご説明しますので、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will start with identity verification and include the discovery. We will explain the current status and next options separately so they are clear. This way, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの商品について、気になる状態をお聞かせいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you describe the condition that concerns you about the item you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った二枚組の洗濯ネットです。一枚を使った後で、もう一枚の縫い目に穴があることに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入した二枚組のうち一枚を使用後、もう一枚の縫い目の穴に気づいたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: These are a two-pack of laundry nets bought yesterday. After using one, I noticed a hole in the seam of the other.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that after using one net from yesterday's two-pack, you noticed a seam hole in the other. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今こちらにお持ちなのは、使ったほうでしょうか。それとも、穴のあるほうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you brought the used one or the one with the hole?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ってきたのは穴のある未使用の一枚です。使った一枚は家で干していて、今日は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参したのは穴のある未使用品で、使用した一枚は自宅で干しており持っていないと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the unused one with the hole. The used one is drying at home and is not here today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought the unused damaged one; the used net is drying at home and was not brought. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二枚組だったことも含めて状態を確認します。購入が分かるものや外側の包装はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the condition, including that it was a two-pack. Do you have proof of purchase or the outer packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートと二枚組と書かれた袋があります。開けた日も昨日ですが、穴がいつからあったかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートと二枚組の袋を示し、開封は昨日だが穴の発生時点は分からないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the receipt and bag marked two-pack. I opened it yesterday too, but do not know when the hole first appeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and two-pack bag, and explain that you opened it yesterday but do not know when the hole occurred. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因は確認できていないとして伺います。どのような対応をご希望かもお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will note that the cause is unconfirmed. What response would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: できれば穴のある一枚を交換してほしいです。ただ、二枚組なので、使ったほうも持ってくる必要があるか尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 穴のある一枚の交換を希望しつつ、使用済みのもう一枚も必要か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If possible, I would like the net with the hole exchanged. But because it is a two-pack, I want to ask whether I must bring the used one too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request an exchange of the damaged net and ask whether the other used net is also required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: セットの扱いと必要な確認物を担当へ照会します。確認の間、商品と包装をお預かりしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask the responsible staff about the set and required items. May we hold the product and packaging while checking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 商品と袋はお渡しします。レシートは手元に残したいので、その場で見てください。必要な持参物が分かれば、改めてそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品と袋を預け、レシートはその場の確認だけにし、必要物が判明後にそろえ直すと申し出る。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over the product and bag. I want to keep the receipt, so please inspect it here. Once I know what is needed, I will gather it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the product and bag, ask for the receipt to be inspected only on the spot, and offer to gather required items once known. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、レシートは拝見してお返しします。交換できる範囲を決めたわけではありませんので、担当の回答と次の持ち物を先にご案内します。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we will inspect and return the receipt. We have not decided what can be exchanged, so will first explain the staff's answer and what to bring next. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内図のどの経路を歩くか、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice on which route on the park map to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この周回路をベビーカーで歩きたいです。途中に階段の印がありますが、逆回りにすれば避けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーで周回路を歩きたく、階段を逆回りで避けられるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to take this loop with a stroller. There is a stair symbol partway along. Can I avoid it by going the other way around?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to use the loop with a stroller and ask whether going in reverse avoids the stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一周すると、向きを変えても同じ階段を通る図です。階段を使わないことを優先なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The map shows that completing the loop uses the same stairs in either direction. Is avoiding stairs your priority?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、ベビーカーを持ち上げて運ぶ予定はありません。逆回りなら違う道になると思っていたので、一周の計画を変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段を使わずベビーカーを持ち上げない方針を伝え、逆回りの思い込みを改め一周計画を変更する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I do not plan to carry the stroller. I thought reversing direction would mean a different path, so I will change the full-loop plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will avoid stairs and not carry the stroller, correct your assumption about reversing direction, and change the loop plan. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周回路とは別に、入口側の広場を囲む経路があります。この図では階段の印がありませんが、現地の通行表示もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separate from the loop, there is a route around the plaza near the entrance. This map has no stair symbol there, but check the actual access signs too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長い周回路とは別なのですね。広場の近くで途中に座れる場所も、図で分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長い周回路とは別の広場経路だと確認し、近くの座れる場所が図で分かるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it is separate from the long loop. Can the map also show somewhere nearby to sit along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that this plaza route differs from the long loop and ask whether the map shows nearby seating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここに休憩ベンチの表示があります。空いているかは保証できませんが、近くの職員へ聞くこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a rest-bench symbol here. We cannot guarantee a free seat, but you can also ask nearby staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 席が空いている前提にはしません。まず広場の範囲だけ歩き、休める状況を見て、長く歩くか決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 空席を当然とせず、広場の範囲から歩いて休憩状況を見て長さを決めたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume seats are free. I want to start within the plaza, see whether I can rest, then decide how long to walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume seating is available, will start in the plaza, and decide the walk's length after checking rest opportunities. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰るときは、この入口側へ戻る経路を確認しておきましょう。大きな周回路に続く分かれ道と区別できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the return route toward this entrance. Can you distinguish it from the fork leading to the large loop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広場を囲む線で入口へ戻り、階段のある周回路へつながる分かれ道には進みません。迷ったら図を持って職員に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場の線で入口に戻り階段の周回路へ進まないと確認し、迷えば図を持って職員に尋ねると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will follow the line around the plaza back to the entrance, not the fork to the loop with stairs. If unsure, I will show the map and ask staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm returning to the entrance along the plaza line without entering the stair loop, and say you will ask staff with the map if unsure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、今日は広場の範囲というご希望ですね。図をお持ちください。通行の表示と周りの状況を見ながら、無理のないお散歩をどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, you want to stay within the plaza today. Please take the map. Check access signs and your surroundings, and enjoy a manageable walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符の購入画面で、お困りの所がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something troubling you on the ticket purchase screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日帰りなので往復を選びました。帰りの列車を選ぶ画面ですが、まだ時間を決めていないので適当に選んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日帰りの往復購入で帰りが未定のため、適当な列車を選んでよいか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose a return because it is a day trip. This screen asks for the return train, but I have not decided the time. May I choose any train for now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may select an arbitrary return train when buying a day-return ticket with the return time undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あとで別の列車を使えると、今の段階で決めつけないようにしましょう。帰りの予定は、何に合わせてお決めになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's not assume at this stage that you can use a different train later. What will determine your return plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人との用事が終わったら帰ります。終わる時刻は未定なので、表示された列車に必ず乗れるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人との用事の終了時刻が未定で、表示列車に必ず乗れるとは言えないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will return after finishing something with a friend. The finish time is undecided, so I cannot promise I will catch the train shown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the activity with your friend has no fixed finish time, so you cannot promise to take the displayed train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その条件を伺ってから、選べる切符を確認します。今の画面の選択は、まだ購入を確定していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check ticket options after hearing those conditions. Your current screen selection has not yet confirmed a purchase, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、決済はしていません。行きの列車は決めてあるので、帰りを決めずに買う方法があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 決済前で行きの列車は決めてあり、帰りを未定にした購入方法を知りたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Correct, I have not paid. I have chosen the outward train, so I want to know whether I can buy without deciding the return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say payment is not complete, your outward train is decided, and you want a purchase method leaving the return undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行きだけを買う案も含めて担当に確認しましょう。まず行き先と、行く日付を画面でお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's ask staff, including about buying only the outward journey. First, show your destination and travel date on the screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行き先はこちらで、日付は今日です。帰りを別にする場合の条件を聞いてから、行きだけにするか選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日の行先を示し、帰りを別に買う条件を聞いてから行きだけの購入を選ぶと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the destination, and the date is today. I will choose whether to buy outward only after hearing the conditions for buying the return separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show today's destination and say you will choose outward-only purchase after hearing the conditions for a separate return purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。往復の価格だけで比べず、帰りに使える条件や、別に購入する場合も確認するということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. You will compare not only return prices, but also return-use conditions and separate purchase, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その点を先に聞きます。今の帰りの選択は確定させず、条件と合計額を確認してから支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰りの選択を確定せず、利用条件と合計額を確認した後に払うと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask those points first. I will not confirm the current return selection, and will pay after checking the conditions and total amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the return selection unconfirmed and pay after checking use conditions and the total. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、購入前のご相談としてこちらで伺います。画面は確定せず、そのまま担当へお見せください。それでは、切符の相談窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will handle this as a pre-purchase consultation. Do not confirm the screen; show it to the staff as it is. Please go to the ticket advice counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた通知についてですね。今日は原本をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a notice you received. Have you brought the original today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 原本は家に置いてきました。この写真を見て、何をいつまでに出すのか教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原本は家にあり、写真で提出物と期限を知りたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left the original at home. Please look at this photograph and tell me what to submit and by when.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the original is at home and you want to learn the required submissions and deadline from a photograph. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の最後に「裏面に続きます」とありますね。裏面や、同封されていた物の写真もございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The end of this photo says 'continued on the reverse.' Do you also have photos of the reverse and any enclosures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表だけ撮りました。裏に文章があるとは気づかず、封筒の中にほかの紙があったかも覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表面だけ撮り、裏面の文章と同封物の有無は確認していないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only photographed the front. I did not notice writing on the reverse, and cannot remember whether there were other papers in the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only the front was photographed, and the reverse text and any enclosures have not been checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この写真だけで必要な書類や期限を決めず、原本と同封物を確かめましょう。今、用意できている書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the original and enclosures rather than deciding documents and deadlines from this photo alone. Do you have any documents ready now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の情報が分かる書類はありますが、通知で求められた物かは分かりません。不足があるかも含めて相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人情報の書類はあるが通知の指定物か分からず、不足の有無も相談したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have documents showing my personal information, but do not know whether they are what the notice requests. I want to discuss whether anything is missing too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have personal-information documents but do not know whether they are the specified items, and want to discuss possible shortages. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不足していると決まったわけではありませんので、分からない点として担当へ伝えましょう。原本は、ご自宅で見つけられそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It has not been determined that anything is missing, so let's tell the responsible staff what is unclear. Can you find the original at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒ごと机に置いてあります。帰ってから裏面と同封物を確認し、件名と問合せ先も控えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒が家の机にあり、裏面・同封物・件名・問合せ先を帰宅後に確かめると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is on my desk with the envelope. After returning home, I will check the reverse and enclosures, and note the subject and inquiry contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the envelope is on your desk at home and you will check the reverse, enclosures, subject, and contact after returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのうえで担当へ、内容と期限、手元の書類でよいかをお尋ねください。期限が近いかどうかも、原本で確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then ask the responsible staff about the content, deadline, and whether your documents are suitable. Whether the deadline is close also needs checking in the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真にない部分を先にそろえます。期限を自分で推測せず、原本を手元に置いて担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 欠けた部分をそろえ、期限を推測せず原本を手元に担当へ相談すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will gather the parts missing from the photograph first. I will not guess the deadline, and will consult the responsible staff with the original to hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to gather missing parts and consult staff with the original at hand without guessing the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する物が整理できましたね。原本を見ても分かりにくい所は、その箇所を示してお尋ねください。本日のご案内は以上です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have organized what to check. If parts remain unclear after reading the original, point to them when asking. That concludes today's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてのご受診ですね。今お困りの症状を、いつからかも含めて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Please explain your symptoms, including when they began.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方からのどが痛いです。こちらは初めてなので、受付で先に何を伝えるかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日夕方からのどが痛く初診で、受付で何を伝えるかも分からないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My throat has hurt since yesterday evening. This is my first visit here, so I do not even know what to say to reception first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your throat has hurt since yesterday evening, this is your first visit, and you do not know what to tell reception. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状を伺いながらご案内します。今日、飲んだ薬や、今続けて飲んでいる薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will guide you while asking about symptoms. Have you taken any medicine today, or are you taking any regularly?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝、前に別の所でもらった白い薬を一つ飲みました。名前は覚えていません。白い色だけでは分かりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前別の所でもらった白い薬一つを今朝飲んだが名前が不明で、色で分かるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This morning I took one white medicine previously given to me elsewhere. I cannot remember the name. Can it be identified by the white color alone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you took one white medicine from another provider this morning, do not know its name, and ask whether color identifies it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色や個数だけで薬の名前は決められません。薬袋や説明書など、名前を確認できる物はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Color or number alone cannot identify a medicine. Do you have a medicine bag or instructions that show the name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここには持っていませんが、今朝飲んだ薬の袋は家にあります。家族に頼んで、その袋の名前と説明が写った写真を送ってもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今朝飲んだ薬の袋は家にあるため、その薬名と説明が写る写真を家族から送ってもらいたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not here, but the bag for this morning's medicine is at home. I want to ask my family to send a photo showing the name and instructions on that bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the bag for this morning's medicine is at home and you want family to send a photo showing its name and instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる情報を集めて、担当へお見せください。写真を待つ間も、飲んだ時刻など覚えていることは伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Gather what information you can and show the staff. While waiting for the photo, can you tell us what you remember, such as when you took it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 朝食の後に一つ飲みました。正確な名前は確認中だと伝え、色から自分で書き込まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 朝食後に一つ飲んだ事実を伝え、薬名は確認中として色から記入しないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I took one after breakfast. I will say the exact name is being checked, and not fill it in myself based on the color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you took one after breakfast and will mark the name as being checked rather than fill it in from color. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、分かる事実と確認中の情報を分けましょう。薬をこの後どうするかは、診察で医師へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, separate known facts from information being checked. Please consult the doctor during your examination about what to do with the medicine next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 薬袋の写真が届いたら、読めるか一緒に確かめてほしいです。のどが痛み始めた時刻と、今朝飲んだことも医師に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 薬袋写真の読取りを手伝ってほしいと求め、症状の開始と今朝の服用を医師へ伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: When the bag photo arrives, please help me check whether it is readable. I will also tell the doctor when the throat pain began and that I took medicine this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for help reading the medicine-bag photo and say you will tell the doctor the symptom onset and this morning's dose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今のお話を医師へ引き継ぎます。写真が届きましたら職員へお知らせください。それでは、受付の記入をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will pass this account to the doctor. Tell staff when the photo arrives. Now I will explain the reception form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの鍵について、どのようなご用件でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to do regarding the keys you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が拾った鍵です。友人は今ここへ来られないので、私が代わりに届けに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人が拾った鍵を、来られない友人に代わって届けに来たと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend found these keys. My friend cannot come now, so I have brought them in on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are handing in keys found by a friend who cannot come. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身が拾われたのではないのですね。鍵を受け取ったのは、いつ、どこでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you did not find them yourself. When and where did you receive them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は昼に友人の家で受け取りました。拾ったのも昼だったかどうかは、私は聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日昼に友人宅で受け取ったが、拾った時刻は聞いていないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I received them at my friend's home at noon today. I have not asked whether they were also found at noon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you received them at your friend's home at noon today, but have not heard the time they were found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取った時刻と、拾った時刻は別に記録します。発見した場所は、何と聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will record receiving and finding times separately. What have you heard about where they were found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 公園の水飲み場の近くと聞きましたが、私はその場所で鍵を見ていません。どの公園かも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水飲み場近くと聞いただけで現場を見ておらず、公園名も要確認だと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I heard near a drinking fountain in a park, but did not see the keys there myself. I also need to check which park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you only heard they were near a drinking fountain, did not see the scene, and need to check the park name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 聞いた内容として伺います。友人の方に、場所と時刻を確認できる連絡手段はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will take that as reported information. Can you contact your friend to check the place and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯に連絡できます。今、私から公園の名前と見つけた時刻を聞き、友人自身が説明できるかも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人に連絡して公園名・発見時刻と、本人から説明できるかを確かめると申し出る。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can call their mobile. I will ask the park's name and discovery time now, and whether my friend can explain directly too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to contact your friend to check the park name, discovery time, and whether they can explain themselves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認できない点を、ご自身の記憶として埋めないようにしてください。お持ちになった方の連絡先も担当が伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Do not fill unknown points in as your own memories. Staff will also ask for the contact details of the person bringing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が直接知っているのは、今日友人から受け取ったことです。自分の連絡先をお伝えし、発見状況は友人から確認した内容として説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 直接知るのは受渡しだけと述べ、自分の連絡先を示し発見状況は友人の報告として伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: What I know directly is that I received them from my friend today. I will give my contact details and explain the discovery as information confirmed with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you directly know only the handover, provide your contact details, and describe the discovery as your friend's report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別で担当へおつなぎします。鍵は、持参された経緯と一緒に確認いたしますので、こちらでお話をお続けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you to the staff with that distinction. We will check the keys together with how they came to be brought here, so please continue your account here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関する手続きのことでしょうか。今日は何をお確かめになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about moving procedures? What would you like to check today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯で手続きをしたつもりですが、まだ前の住所に手紙が来たそうです。同じ申込みをもう一度すればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯で手続きしたつもりだが旧住所へ手紙が届き、再申込みすべきか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I completed the procedure on my phone, but apparently a letter still arrived at the old address. Should I submit the same application again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought you completed the procedure on your phone, but a letter reached the old address, and ask whether to reapply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に、どこまで進めたかを確認しましょう。最後に表示された画面や、受付に関する連絡は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's check how far you got. Do you still have the final screen or any message about acceptance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この画面を保存しました。よく見ると「入力内容を保存」とあります。これで受付も済んだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保存画面は入力内容を保存という表示で、受付も済んだと思っていたと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I saved this screen. Looking closely, it says 'save entered details.' I thought that also meant the application had been received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the saved screen says 'save entered details' and you thought acceptance was also complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存の表示だけでは、受付済みかどうかは分かりません。受付についてのメールなども、別に受け取っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A saved display alone does not show whether it was received. Have you separately received an acceptance email or similar message?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受信した物をまだ全部見ていません。申し込んだ時刻の前後の連絡を調べ、分からない物は担当に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受信物を全部見ていないため申込み前後の連絡を調べ、判断できない物を担当へ示したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not checked everything received yet. I want to check messages around the time I applied and show the responsible staff anything I cannot interpret.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked all incoming messages, will check around the application time, and want to show unclear ones to staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面と連絡をそろえて相談しましょう。手紙が旧住所へ届いたことだけで、申込みが失敗したとも決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's consult with both the screen and messages. Do not conclude the application failed solely because a letter reached the old address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それだけでは判断できないのですね。重ねて送る前に、保存した日時と入力に使った情報を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所の配達だけで判断せず、追加送信前に保存日時と入力に使った情報を整理すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So that alone is not enough to judge. Before sending another application, I will organize the saved date and time and the information used for entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not judge from old-address delivery alone and will organize the saved date, time, and entered information before another submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で担当が確認方法をご案内します。受付の状況と、郵便がどう扱われるかは分けてお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The responsible staff will explain how to check from that information. Ask about acceptance status separately from how the mail will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず受付が済んでいるかを相談します。前の住所に届いた手紙の宛先と日付も確かめ、今後の確認方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に受付状況を尋ね、旧住所に届いた手紙の宛先と配達日も確認して、今後の確認方法を聞くと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask whether acceptance is complete. I will also check the addressee and date of the letter delivered to the old address, and ask how to check from now on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first ask the acceptance status, check the addressee and delivery date of the old-address letter, and ask how to check going forward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認したい点がまとまりましたね。画面をそのままご用意のうえ、こちらの担当へご相談ください。今は追加の申込みを決めずにご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your questions are organized. Keep the screen ready as it is and consult this staff member. We will guide you without deciding on an additional application now.
